prompt: Which creates a Map from names to ages and looks up 'Bob' with a default of -1 if absent?
choices: Map<String,Integer> m = new HashMap<>(); m.put("Alice",30); int age = m["Bob"];
Map<String,Integer> m = new HashMap<>(); m.put("Alice",30); int age = m.getOrDefault("Bob",-1);
Map<String,Integer> m = new HashMap<>(); m.put("Alice",30); int age = m.get("Bob",-1);
Map<String,Integer> m = new HashMap<>(); m.put("Alice",30); int age = m.getOrDefault("Bob", null);
explanation: getOrDefault(key, default) returns the value if present, or the default otherwise. Option A uses array syntax (invalid for Map). Option C: get() takes only one argument. Option D: null as the default would cause NullPointerException when unboxing to int.
